title: 4th ESC Hurricane Harvey Response 2017
description: After the devastation caused by Hurricane Harvey, members of the 4th Sustainment Command (Expeditionary) responded to several assistance requests from local authorities.  The U.S. Army Reserve is the most capable, combat ready and lethal Federal Reserve force our Nation has ever seen.
keywords: US Army Reserve, DSCA, IRA, soldiers, lethal, 4th ESC, 4th Expeditionary Sustainment Command, capable, 4th Sustainment Command Expeditionary, combat-ready, Immediate Response Authority, Hurricane Harvey, Harvey 2017, Hurricane Irma, Irma 2017, army, Texas, Houston

transcript.text: - [Newscaster] Texas right now, is in the grip of the most
powerful storm to hit
the United States... - Rain coming down sideways...
- [Reporter] The flooding will continue.
(news reporters all talking at once)
- [Reporter] Thousands of people are in need of rescue...
(slow rock music)
- It's Staff Seargent Clever and (mumbles).
We're moving out, water's about five feet,
between four and a half and five feet,
beyond up to our door and under the cab
but we're trying keep pushing through
we got a lot of people stranded.
(slow rock music)
- The great relationship that
the United States Army Reserves
has with their local community here in Houston,
everybody coming together
from the local government to the Emergency First Responders
to civilian assets,
everybody coming together and just donating.
(slow rock music)
I feel very proud to be able to support and assist

we're all pulling together.
